color.side-bg: Left sidebar and the settings window's side column; group headings in lists. The darkest ground in dark mode.
color.bg: Page background behind the main column; also the fill of text inputs (and the command palette's search field) that sit on a surface.
color.surface: Raised surfaces on bg: cards, list rows, panels, buttons, the command palette and dialogs.
color.text: Primary text and headings on bg, side-bg, surface and neutral-bg.
color.text-2: Secondary text: labels, sub-lines, close buttons. 4.5:1 on every ground in both themes.
color.text-3: Tertiary text: counts, separators, sidebar section headings on side-bg, icon strokes.
color.muted: Alias of text-2 for meta text (paths, times, process names); the most used text colour after text.
color.line: Hairline borders and dividers: cards, rows, inputs, buttons. Borders, not shadows, separate surfaces.
color.neutral-bg: Quiet fills: tags, badges, kbd keys, meter tracks, remote-host rows.
color.accent: Links, focus outlines, the primary button, tailnet glyphs and the new badge. Text on bg, side-bg, surface, neutral-bg and info-bg.
color.accent-text: Text on an accent fill (primary button, new badge).
color.ok: Up and healthy: status dots, memory sparklines, ok badges. Text on every ground.
color.ok-bg: Fill behind ok badges, the alert channel's ok row and service tiles.
color.warn: Degraded or needs a look: warn dots, LAN glyphs, warn tags. Text on every ground.
color.warn-bg: Fill behind warn tags and badges and the read-only notice in settings.
color.info: Informational marks: compute-pool glyphs, VM type tags, the palette's port rows, info badges.
color.info-bg: Fill behind info marks and the selected command-palette row.
color.danger: Down, failed or destructive: bad dots, danger buttons and palette verbs. Text on every ground.
color.danger-text: Text on a danger fill (error toasts).
color.st-divider: Settings window: dividers between rows, list items and key-value pairs.
color.st-hover: Settings window and control menus: hover fill of tabs, the close button and menu options.
color.st-current: Settings window: the current tab's fill.
color.st-seg-on: Segmented control: the chosen option's fill (surface in light, a lighter grey in dark).

fs-1.usage: 11px: key caps, the sidebar's mono sub-lines, the inspector's log text and source line.

fs-2.usage: 12px: meta lines of list rows, sidebar counts and section headings, inspector section headings and facts, row action buttons.

fs-3.usage: 13px: shell tabs, secondary sidebar items, the inspector body, list group heads, toasts, and the port number of a list row on desktop.

fs-4.usage: 14px: body text (the body font size), row names, sidebar view rows and the settings window.

fs-5.usage: 15px: the page title in the bar, the inspector title, the keyboard shortcuts heading, and a list row's port number on a phone.

figure-port.usage: The base port figure (600, 18px mono) of a service row; inside the dashboard list it drops to 13px on desktop and 15px on a phone.

figure-port-sm.usage: A port number inside a row (other hosts' ports).

figure-access-code.usage: The one-time approval code in Settings, spaced for reading aloud.

layout.side-w: Width of the left sidebar (0px while it is closed: data-side="closed").
layout.insp-w: Width of the right inspector (0px while closed, 300px with data-insp="open").
layout.col-max: Maximum width of the main column.
layout.col-wide: Maximum width of the main column on the devices tab.
layout.col-pad: Side padding of the main column: 20px, 0 from 641px to 767px, 16px at 640px and below.

shadow.name: shadow-dialog
shadow.usage: The command palette and the keyboard shortcuts dialog, floating over the page.

shadow.name: shadow-toast
shadow.usage: Toasts at the bottom of the page.

shadow.name: shadow-drawer
shadow.usage: The sidebar when it slides in as a drawer on narrow windows.

shadow.name: shadow-sheet
shadow.usage: The inspector when it opens as a right sheet under 1200px.

radius.name: radius-4
radius.usage: kbd keys, VM type tags, small icon buttons.

radius.name: radius-6
radius.usage: Palette verbs, menu options, segmented options, inline code.

radius.name: radius-7
radius.usage: Shell tabs and bar icon buttons; also the app icon's corner.

radius.name: radius-8
radius.usage: Buttons, inputs and selects: the default control radius; also the dense list container on desktop.

radius.name: radius-10
radius.usage: Toasts, the ⋯ menu panel, service tiles, notices and the list container on a phone.

radius.name: radius-12
radius.usage: Cards, the command palette, dialogs, worktree groups; the base service row outside the dense list.

radius.name: radius-14
radius.usage: Device cards and the network tree on the devices tab.
